name: Hangjin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangjin Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chlor-alkali chemical and electronic products in China and internationally. The company offers chemical products, including caustic soda, propylene oxide, polyether, polyvinyl chloride, chlorinated benzene, and liquid chlorine for used by various industries, such as alumina, steel, chemical fiber, papermaking, chemicals, medicine, polyurethane, and construction industries.
